title: Scaffold Expo app skeleton with email/password auth
userStory: As a Structly user I want to install the app and sign in with email/password so I can reach the capture screen.
acceptanceCriteria: npx expo start boots the app without errors
Navigation includes a Sign-In screen and a Capture home screen
Supabase email/password sign-in creates a session and routes to the Capture screen
No Google OAuth dependency is present in package.json
